617:t_017:14.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Are you saying you yourself became the one who rules that fundamental calamity?」

617:t_017:15.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Because I judged it necessary to do so.」

617:t_017:17.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I seek even greater power! $c...! It is you!」

617:t_018:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「So you went and summoned $$次元獣$$s!」

617:t_018:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「They're a different kind from the ones that were with $$ガイオウ$$!」

617:t_018:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$ヴィルダーク$$! Are you planning to turn us into $$次元獣$$s too!?」

617:t_018:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「There's no need for that.」

617:t_018:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「A $$次元獣$$ does strengthen man and machine. But that is where the strength ends.」

617:t_018:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「In the end, it can't match a warrior who grows without limit.」

617:t_018:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「You're saying the same thing as $$ガイオウ$$!」

617:t_018:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I... seek limitless strength. To get it, I need battles with the strong.」

617:t_018:9.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$悲しみの乙女$$, $$傷だらけの獅子$$, $$揺れる天秤$$, $$いがみ合う双子$$... Offer up your $$スフィア$$s to me.」

617:t_018:10.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「And you, $c! You will become the sacrifices that make me grow!」

617:t_018:12.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We will not accept anyone who sacrifices others for their own goals!」

617:t_018:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「In the end, you're the same as $$ガイオウ$$ at the root. I can't let a guy like that slide.」

617:t_018:14.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That's good! You would rather be my enemies than become my comrades!」

617:t_018:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「No matter where this guy came from, he's still a $$サイデリアル$$ and the Emperor of the $$新地球皇国$$. That hasn't changed!」

617:t_018:17.en:
$$万丈$$
「Now that you've brought out all of that, all that's left is to fight until one side wins!」

617:t_018:18.en:
$$シモン$$
「And the ones who'll win are us!」

617:t_018:19.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Come, $c! The power of a $$次元将$$ and four $$スフィア$$s! I'll test it on you!」

617:t_018:20.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I am the $$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$! The strongest power, one that surpasses even fate!」

617:t_021:1.en:
$$チコ$$
「You're saying that's the power of a $$スフィア$$ too!?」

617:t_021:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「No! That $$次元力$$ is being supplied from the Imperial Palace!」

617:t_021:3.en:
$$カヲル$$
「That place has a system that controls this planet's $$オリジン・ロー$$.」

617:t_021:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So they're using the spirit quanta... the life force of the people they abducted from all over!」

617:t_021:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「But the people whose life energy is absorbed that way...!」

617:t_021:6.en:
$n
「They get $$血塗られた眼$$ and become little more than empty shells...」

617:t_021:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「That's low, Dimensional Emperor! Forcibly making the power of Earth's people your own!」

617:t_021:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Say what you will. I make everything I can use my own power.」

617:t_021:9.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Is that why you took the $$スフィア$$s of $$バルビエル$$ and the others...!」

617:t_021:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm not about to sympathize with a villain, but it's not pleasant to watch.」

617:t_021:11.en:
$$ランド$$
「Still, now we know the trick! If we smash that ridiculously huge building, they can't use that cheat anymore!」

617:t_021:12.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「It's useless. The Imperial Palace is surrounded by an absolute barrier.」

617:t_021:13.en:
$n
「The force that stopped me when I charged in before...!」

617:t_021:15.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'll teach you something, $$ヴィルダーク$$...! There's no such thing as absolute in this world!」

617:t_021:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Though the charge was stopped, at that time $n briefly awakened the $$いがみ合う双子$$ to the Third Stage.」

617:t_021:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$ is something of a similar form to the principle of that absolute barrier... In other words, they are the same in nature.」

617:t_021:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Fire can't be put out within fire, and water doesn't dissolve into water. That's just how it is.」

617:t_021:20.en:
$$トライア$$
「The absolute you believe in had been scratched, faint as it was!」

617:t_022:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「There's no way that little bit of event control could change the flow of the $$オリジン・ロー$$ at the Imperial Palace!」

617:t_022:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I myself don't think such a thing is possible, you know.」

617:t_022:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「What we did earlier was to deliver our voices, our will, our feelings to the people inside the $$霊子吸収システム$$.」

617:t_023:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ユニコーン$$! Carry my... our feelings!」

617:t_024:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll use the $$ＹＦ－２９$$'s Fold Wave System too!」

617:t_025:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「All right, you guys! You're really getting into it now!」

617:t_026:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
($$ナナリー$$! If you can hear my voice, lend me your strength!)

617:t_026:2.en:

(Lend me your feelings and your strength!)

617:t_026:3.en:
$$刹那$$
($$マリナ・イスマイール$$! Lend me your wish for peace!)
